title: re-isre-bundle/1: the header line of an ISRE composition export
description: The first line of POST /api/isre-composition/export (application/x-ndjson). Each later line is a re-isre-composition/1 record exactly as its segment stored it (RealityEngine_CI SURFACE_SPEC.md 'The PE half: ISRE composition').

instance.description: The RE this PE recorded against; empty before the first record.

count.description: Lines after the header: records, plus each K-line's re-kline-event/1 lines.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of every byte after the header line (each line ending \n).
